title: RTMP or SRT for sending the feed from a remote location?
body: RTMP is accepted almost everywhere, while SRT promises better recovery on shaky links. If you send a feed from a venue, a mobile connection or a second site, which protocol do you use and what is on the receiving end?

Many open source servers handle both: the [MediaMTX repository](https://github.com/bluenviron/mediamtx) lists SRT, WebRTC, RTSP, RTMP, LL-HLS, MPEG-TS and RTP, and the [SRS site](https://ossrs.io/lts/en-us/) lists RTMP, WebRTC, HLS, HTTP-FLV, SRT and MPEG-DASH. Whether a platform accepts SRT directly or only RTMP decides how many hops you need.
Share your link type (wired, bonded cellular, satellite), what loss you saw and how you tuned latency settings.
